authorization.scope: Repair the fixed-source review lifecycle and bounded text coverage, then use CI-checked PR review. No author message, contact reservation, Catalog content change, or third-party code execution in this plan.

implementation: Treat a changed full fixed Commit as a new admission decision so prior manual approvals or rejections cannot silently follow the source.
Recheck entries whose admission engine, policy digest, or review-registry digest is stale, and persist a refreshed binding even when the displayed status is unchanged.
Include bounded Lean source/templates, MANIFEST.sha256, and .gitkeep text files in fixed-source scan coverage.

gates.npmRunCheck: An initial full run passed 670 tests before the final exact-Commit recheck helper. The final full rerun was stopped by ENOSPC in a Marketplace static-build fixture; final focused tests passed 38/38. Full PR CI must pass before merge.
